summary.text: Mark Evans is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Coos 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as acupuncturist and notes that he previously served as a city councilor in Berlin, New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Mark Evans graduated from Profile High School in Bethlehem, New Hampshire, in 1983 and earned a bachelor's degree from Plymouth State University in 1988.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as acupuncturist.
Evans was the Republican nominee for New Hampshire State Senate District 1 in 2014, when he received 39.8 percent of the vote against Democratic incumbent Jeff Woodburn.
In 2020 he ran for the New Hampshire House of Representatives in Coos 3, receiving 1,560 votes in a race where three candidates were elected; he was not among them.
In 2026 Evans and incumbent Peter Morency advanced from the Republican primary for Coos 5, and Evans appears on the November general election ballot alongside Morency and independent Cassie Mason.
